summary: A GUI process started without handles (as Steam starts the game) gets NULL standard handles, no console, and Windows's answers from GetStdHandle, SetStdHandle, GetFileType, GetConsoleMode, GetConsoleCP, WriteConsoleW, FlushFileBuffers, GetStartupInfoW, GetCommandLineW and GetCommandLineA.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C)

initial.process: started by the runner's cmd with standard output redirected

acceptance.derivation: scripts/family_run.py console_rows: The title's length is the runner's path length (D:\a\w2m\w2m\probe.exe); the row keeps only that the title is the module's path.

open_questions: The rows come from a child the probe starts with no inherited handles and an empty STARTUPINFO; that Steam starts the game the same way is the BLACKBOARD's assumption of 2026-10-10 (revisit with Steam in the local VM).
GetStartupInfoW leaves hStdInput, hStdOutput and hStdError unwritten when the start passed no handles: the probe's fill survives (row startup_info.child.values).
The title's length is the runner's path and is dropped from the rows; the title being the module path is kept.
